name: Brumal-Fathom
description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against acid rain regions, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Leviathan fauna breach the sea-mist at dusk, singing on frequencies felt in the teeth.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on water, rare flora, exotic matter and biomass are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
